upload.command_note: Hugging Face opens the pull request as a refs/pr/N revision inside the source repository, so write access to ai-dynamo/aisim-data is required; a fork does not work. Only the first upload passes --create-pr; the rest target that PR's refs/pr/N so every artifact lands in one reviewed revision. hf upload only adds or overwrites, so the six system-level auxiliary files under b200_sxm/ stay in place.

payload.note: the bundle's tables are a re-encoding of these files, not a different measurement

version_slots.detail: Slots are the pinned dataset's own state (identical in the in-tree systems/query_versions.yaml); `next` derives to `current` because no newer version has data. sglang 0.5.21 is `previous`, so publishing the tables and raising the pin is enough. vllm 0.31.0 is outside both slots (current 0.32.0, previous 0.30.0), so a default query still raises UnlistedQueryVersionError until 0.31.0 is promoted into a slot or the caller sets AIC_ALLOW_UNLISTED_VERSIONS=1 (the only escape hatch; there is no CLI flag).
